title: Raise OIRA funding and staff regulatory advance teams, separate from reviewers
uncertainties: checked systematically on 2026-10-15: (1) federalregister.gov API, Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs in OMB documents since 2025-01-20: 11 documents (acquisition rules, Statistical Policy Directive 8, a financial assistance proposed rule, performance review board notices, a deregulation request), none on OIRA funding, staffing or advance teams. (2) reginfo.gov Unified Agenda: not applicable to an internal staffing matter and not searched. (3) congress.gov: not fetched (robots restriction); the House Appropriations host release on the FY27 Financial Services bill gives a bill-wide total of about 25.3 billion dollars, about 3.8 percent below FY2026, with no OMB or OIRA line, and mentions codifying the REINS Act; full bill text and report were not read. (4) whitehouse.gov and omb: the FY2026 and FY2027 OMB budget justifications were not located. (5) news: two web searches on OIRA staffing, budget and advance teams returned only pre-2025 analyses (2016 to 2021 and a 2025 CRS overview). Staffing levels are therefore unknown, and the not_started finding rests on absence in these checks.
